integrity: All displayed witness identities and inequalities are replayed with exact rational arithmetic in verifier.py.
The comparison distinguishes the paper's incorrect fixed-parameter sufficiency statement in Theorem 6 from its later mode-by-mode formulas, which are compatible with the corrected criterion.
limitations: Linear stability only; no nonlinear pattern-existence or attractor-selection claim is made.
The exact witness uses a rational competition coefficient chosen from the coexistence equation rather than the source paper's illustrative c=1.1.
title: Discrete Neumann modes are the missing condition in the bounded-domain Turing criterion
